title: Nellis Desert Self-Drive Off-Road Jeep Tour from Las Vegas
includes: Photos and videos taken by our guides are included at no additional charge.
Guide gratuities are not included and are optional but greatly appreciated.
Special dietary foods and other drinks (not included)
requirements: Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Travelers should have at least a moderate level of physical fitness
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Get behind the wheel of your own modified Jeep Rock Crawler on our closest off-road adventure to the Las Vegas Strip. Unlike a ride-along tour, our “You Drive, We Guide” experience puts you in control while a professional guide leads the way in a separate Jeep.

The Nellis desert offers an exciting variety of terrain, including sandy washes, gravel trails, rocky climbs, steep hills and desert ravines. No previous off-road experience is required. Before entering the trail, your guide provides a safety briefing, explains the Jeep’s features and communicates with you by radio throughout the tour.

Your Jeep, fuel, off-road fees, bottled water, snacks, communication radio, and photos and videos taken by your guide are included. Eligible drivers may switch during the tour so more than one qualified guest can enjoy time behind the wheel.
